en.headline: Hong Kong launches 60-hour cybersecurity attack-and-defence drill
en.dek: The Digital Policy Office’s three-day exercise involves 51 blue teams from government, public bodies and private firms for the first time, testing responses to simulated threats.
body: The Hong Kong Cybersecurity Attack and Defence Drill 2026 began on Thursday and will run for 60 hours until the evening of 31 October. Organised by the Digital Policy Office, it tests the defence and incident-response capabilities of participating organisations through simulated cyber-threat scenarios.

For the first time, private enterprises have joined as defending blue teams alongside government departments and public organisations. A total of 51 blue teams are taking part, comprising 28 government departments and 23 public organisations and private enterprises, each defending designated information systems.

Twenty-three red teams are conducting the simulated attacks. They include cybersecurity firms from Hong Kong and the Mainland, higher-education institutions and teams recommended by the Guangdong Provincial Internet Information Office. The Digital Policy Office has also invited 17 cybersecurity firms to provide technical support to the blue teams, and more than 80 organisations are attending as observers.

Secretary for Innovation, Technology and Industry Sun Dong spoke at the opening ceremony, saying the government is coordinating development and security and strengthening cybersecurity collaboration. The exercise is co-hosted with the Office of the Commissioner of Critical Infrastructure (Computer-system Security), the Police Force’s Cyber Security and Technology Crime Bureau, the Hong Kong Internet Registration Corporation, Cyberport and industry associations.

zh.headline: 香港網絡安全攻防演練展開 為期60小時
zh.dek: 數字政策辦公室主辦的三日演練首次邀請私營企業加入防守方，共51支藍隊參與，測試應對模擬網絡威脅的能力。
body: 「香港網絡安全攻防演練—以攻築防2026」周四起展開，為期三日兩夜共60小時，將於10月31日晚結束。演練由數字政策辦公室牽頭主辦，透過模擬真實網絡威脅場景，測試參與機構的防禦部署及應變能力。
今年首次邀請私營企業加入防守方（藍隊），與政府部門及公共機構一同參與。共有51支藍隊，包括28個政府部門及23間公共機構和私營企業，各自防守指定資訊系統。
23支紅隊負責模擬攻擊，包括本港及內地網絡安全機構、大專院校及廣東省互聯網信息辦公室推薦的隊伍。數字辦亦邀請17間網絡安全企業為藍隊提供技術支援，另有超過80家機構的代表以觀察員身分到場。
創新科技及工業局局長孫東在開幕典禮致辭，表示政府堅持統籌發展和安全，加強網絡安全協作。演練由保安局關鍵基礎設施專員辦公室、警方網絡安全及科技罪案調查科、香港互聯網註冊管理有限公司、數碼港及業界協會協辦。
